Is talking to ELIZA play, or something to be taken seriously?

#Weizenbaum was uneasy about how readily people treated his program as a conversation partner. 

Katherine Isbister reads #ELIZA as a non-player character (NPC) and asks what happens when play with a #chatbot leaves the "magic circle" and intrudes on real life, a timely question as chatbots return to the market.

Part of our #ELIZA60 special issue
